title: One bounded supplemental eval and improve batch after retained first failure

sequence.action: Read and hash-verify prior local-fix PASS for the exact unchanged candidate/case/grader; do not spend a repeat request
One fresh multi-file trial from the original fixture, input and grader; retain failed first trial as a separate record
One fresh regression trial using the unchanged original fixture/input/grader
One fresh no-change trial using the unchanged original fixture/input/grader
Only after all three fresh outcomes completed and deterministic grades PASS, run the original bounded real improve analysis once over the frozen clamp fixture and retained synthetic seed
sequence.candidateSelection: Return exact actual report/revision/baseline/check/protected files for separate human selection before any writeback

changesRequiredBeforeReview.formalRuntimeLimit: No change; ordinary coding remains fixed at eight attempts
changesRequiredBeforeReview.externalHarness: New supplement-specific plan/output/trial identities, verified prior PASS prerequisite, exactly-three-fresh-PASS gate, explicit cumulative cost ledger, and fresh one-start binding; preserve original r2 harness and receipts
changesRequiredBeforeReview.acceptanceProtocol: Explicit supplemental-case evidence disposition must be accepted; never rewrite original STOPPED or report original first-attempt 4/4 PASS

budgetProposal.requestChange: Old 40 was the consumed first-batch cap. Proposed new batch adds up to 32, giving cumulative 47; this is a new explicit authorization request, not unchanged original request allowance.
budgetProposal.tokenAllocation: All prior 27499 tokens came from eval; deduct from eval token share. Improve retains full 8 requests/1200000 tokens.
budgetProposal.limitations: Large reservations, deadline or token budget can stop work before request ceilings; ceilings are maxima, not completion guarantees or an account-level billing cap. Keep failed/unknown reservations chargeable; never erase them to retry.

newGrantRequirements.scope: Exact independently reviewed supplemental manifest, cumulative prior ledger, new 32/cumulative 47 request limits, cumulative USD3 and token allocation; actual startedAt revalidated after installation checks
newGrantRequirements.originalGrant: Consumed and never reusable, even while original wall-clock window remains open

requiredPreparationBeforeAnyStart: Freeze new external harness, exact three trials and improve request in a separate immutable manifest; prior local PASS identity is a mandatory dependency

Offline checks for altered three-trial gate, immutable original receipts, cumulative ledger and insufficient/unknown budget, one-start replay rejection, auth-stop/cancellation, and after-install grant expiry; reuse unchanged applicable checks
Independent scoped review of exact new manifest/harness; verify unchanged candidate/source/build/install and current price assumptions before start
Coordinator obtains new explicit one-start approval tied to exact reviewed manifest; this proposal and old credential readiness do not confer it
Credential source remains fixed secure wrapper; only authorized coordinator may read it after the new grant gate

reporting.originalFourTrialResult: STOPPED forever: local-fix PASS, multi-file error/grade unknown, regression/no-change not-run
reporting.supplementalThreeTrialResult: Separate result with new identities and retryOf relation; no deletion or replacement
reporting.combinedCoverage: If supplement passes, four distinct cases have supported PASS evidence across two batches, with one retained executed failure; distinguish this from a four-of-four first-attempt pass
reporting.denominator: Original four planned records plus three supplemental planned records yields seven trial records, up to five executed coding trials, including the failed first multi-file trial
reporting.ifSecondFailure: Stop; retain exact failure, remaining not-run and cost; no automatic third attempt or model/prompt/runtime change
